task.description: Design the fix for ISS-0169 tranche 1: LUA-05, LUA-06, LUA-07 (context plumbing + capability enforcement + manifest). Read docs/issue-reports/ISS-0169-diagnosis.yaml — decisions D1-D7 and risks R1-R6. Scope is LIMITED to tranche 1 per the 4-requirement batch cap; LUA-08..16 are separate queued runs.
acceptance_criteria: Design artefact covers every acceptance criterion of LUA-05, LUA-06, LUA-07
Capability enforcement design specifies how CapabilitySet reaches the C closure (upvalue or registry) - the diagnosis proved zero upvalues are passed today
No implementation code in the prose design

result.summary: Type E prose design for ISS-0169 tranche 1 (LUA-05/06/07). Chose the LUA_REGISTRYINDEX private-key light-userdata channel (key 'bpm.execution_context') to carry *const ExecutionContext to every lua_CFunction, rejecting both the per-closure upvalue option (repetition invites the same forgotten-site defect) and any _G-based option (script-writable, the existing __limiter__/__failure_reason__ flaw). Specifies: pointer lifetime/ownership invariants CTX-1..CTX-4; a fail-closed gate (CAP-2) where a missing context denies; the denial path as a pushed-then-raised Lua error surfacing to executeScript's caller as a failed ScriptResult; push-before-raise rule ERR-1 (fixes the 'upval'/stack-garbage messages) and no-allocation-across-longjmp rule ERR-2; capability matrix for all 8 Architecture 5.2 functions with now/fail documented as deliberately ungated; canonical capability strings resolved in favour of capabilities.zig (tests/unit/lua_test.zig is the outlier and is corrected); base-library policy (open luaopen_base FIRST then prune load/loadstring/loadfile/dofile/require/getfenv/setfenv/collectgarbage/print/newproxy/module, keeping pairs/pcall/error/type/setmetatable/_G) with a single createSandboxedState constructor so execution_test.zig's sandboxedState() stops building a state the product never builds (SBX-1/SBX-2, fixes R4); LUA-07 load-time entry point executeScriptWithManifest with a canonical manifest hash that now includes the script-source digest (the existing hash covers only limits+caps and cannot detect a manifest paired with a different artifact), constant-time comparison, and manifest_hash recorded on ExecutionContext/ScriptResult with the audit write left to the engine (transition.zig purity precedent). Full public signatures, two new LuaError variants, dependencies, 17 affected files, an explicit NOT-changed section keeping LUA-08..16 out, and 4 recorded follow-ups. lint_design_artefact.py exits 0.
